question: What scope of understanding is sought concerning the eightfold divisions?
premises: The subject concerns divisions of eightfold groups.
The aim is complete knowledge of these divisions.
This knowledge is sought without limit.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and endlessly the divisions of the eightfold groups.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eightfold groups is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: And to know fully and endlessly the division of the eightfold groups.
